newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia Group shares plunge on Seoul bourse.
newsitem.headline: Kia Group shares plunge on Seoul bourse.

text.p: Shares in all six listed units of South Korea's troubled Kia Group plunged shortly after they resumed trading on Wednesday, with four of them going limit-down, brokers said.

The group's flagship carmaker Kia Motors, commercial vehicle producer Asia Motors, Kia Service and Kia Steel went limit-down, while investors were bidding at limit lows for Kisan and Kia Precision, the brokers said.
Local banks decided on Tuesday to rescue the Kia Group, whose carmaking units had been battered by slumping sales. Its woes were compounded by persistent bankruptcy rumours.
The Korea Stock Exchange had halted trading in the six Kia companies on Tuesday afternoon.
"Investors are dumping Kia shares on uncertainty over the group's future," said broker Na Min-ho at Daishin Securities.
Kia Motors fell 1,000 won to 12,400, Asia Motors 280 to 3,270, Kia Service 400 to 5,370 and Kia Steel 220 to 2,620.
